description: This file contains utility functions for type checking and data transformation related to MCP (likely some configuration or data record) records. It provides functions to verify if a value is an MCP config record, convert arbitrary data to string records, and extract string arrays from unknown values.

methods.name: export function isMcpConfigRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> { isMcpConfigRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object and not an array, indicating it is an MCP config record.

methods.name: export function toMcpStringRecord( toMcpStringRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a record of strings, invoking an optional callback for dropped non-string entries.

methods.name: export function toMcpStringArray(value: unknown): string[] | undefined { toMcpStringArray
methods.description: Extracts an array of strings from a value if it is an array, filtering out non-string elements.
